forks.label: Fork in the path
forks.text: The trail splits: a steep ridge or a long valley road.

a.label: Climb the ridge
a.text: Hard going, but you find a cache at the top.

b.label: Take the valley road
b.text: Slow and safe. A traveller meets you further on.

forks.label: River crossing
forks.text: A river blocks the way. There is a ferry and a rope bridge.

a.label: Pay the ferry
a.text: The ferryman tells you where the berries grow.

b.label: Cross the bridge
b.text: It sways, but holds. Your team trusts you a little more.

forks.label: Camp or press on
forks.text: Dusk falls. You could make camp, or push on in the dark.

b.label: Press on
b.text: You arrive early and catch a vendor before the rush.

forks.label: Two tunnels
forks.text: Two tunnels lead out. One glitters, one breathes cold air.

b.label: The cold tunnel
b.text: It comes out at a spring further on.

forks.label: Training or treasure
forks.text: An old trainer offers a lesson, or a map to buried coins.

b.label: Take the map
b.text: You dig up the coins on the next stretch.

forks.label: Berry grove
forks.text: A grove of ripe berries. Eat now, or pack them for later.

start.label: Dropped parcel
start.text: A hiker dropped a parcel. You pick it up to return it.

end.label: Return the parcel
end.text: The hiker is overjoyed and pays you for the trouble.

start.label: Fallen nest
start.text: You put a fallen nest back in its tree.

end.label: The parents return
end.text: A flock leaves you a shiny gift.

start.label: Half a map
start.text: Half of a torn treasure map. The other half must be nearby.

end.label: The other half
end.text: The map leads to an old stash.

start.label: Lost Pokémon
start.text: A lost Pokémon follows you. Its trainer must be ahead.

end.label: Reunion
end.text: Its trainer thanks you with a rare candy.

start.label: A message to deliver
start.text: A ranger asks you to carry a warning up the route.

end.label: Deliver the warning
end.text: The next ranger post patches up your team.

start.label: Plant a seed
start.text: A gardener gives you a seed to plant by the trail.

end.label: Ripe harvest
end.text: On the way back the plant has fruited.

escorts.label: Escort a lost kid
escorts.text: A kid is lost. Walk them to the next town.
escorts.done: The kid's family thanks you warmly.
escorts.fail: The kid got scared and ran home alone.

escorts.label: Escort a researcher
escorts.text: A researcher wants company through the wilds.
escorts.done: The researcher shares their notes and a gift.
escorts.fail: The researcher turned back after the last fight.

escorts.label: Guard a merchant
escorts.text: A merchant needs a guard for a few stops.
escorts.done: The merchant pays you in coin.

escorts.label: Walk an elder home
escorts.text: An elder asks for an arm to lean on.
escorts.done: The elder's family heals your team.
escorts.fail: The elder's family came to fetch them.

rivalLines: {rival} got there first and took the {entry}.
{rival} grabbed the {entry} while you looked the other way.
You hear {rival} laughing. They took the {entry}.
